about: Wowhead's Forever item pages (wowhead.com/forever/item=<id>, the dropped-by list), read in a browser for the 56 recipe items whose every known source belonged to one faction. Four have a creature that drops them; chance = times looted / times the creature was looted. gen_data.py adds a drop here to a recipe the pages give no drop for. The four pages' sold-by lists named the vendors the tables already had (Wenna Silkbeard; Harlown Darkweave; Androd Fadran; Kithas and Lilly), so those recipes lose their 'as in Classic' mark.
